headline: Argentina Central Bank Chief Rejects Devaluation Fears
summary: Central Bank of Argentina President Santiago Bausili stated that companies betting on a devaluation suffered losses, citing guaranteed US swap lines and expressing confidence against currency runs.
why: Central bank currency policies and foreign exchange reserves are key determinants of domestic financial stability, inflation expectations, and sovereign risk.
